tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Eventgrid' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a service pattern module. It bundles multiple related services/configurations.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
